## <a id="status"></a> 📂 API Status & System (2 Endpoints)

### 1. `GET` /v1/health
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-health`
- **Description:** API health check — no auth required
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/health`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (1922ms)`

**Response Structure Example:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "success": true,
  "creator": "DaraTech",
  "workerVersion": "1.5.0",
  "timestamp": "2026-08-05T23:13:13.018Z"
}
```

---

### 2. `GET` /v1/stats
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-stats`
- **Description:** Content library counts — no auth required
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/stats`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (3288ms)`

**Response Structure Example:**
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "creator": "DaraTech",
  "endpoints": 143,
  "channels": 26,
  "keys": 4,
  "issues": 0
}
```

### 16. `GET` /v1/movies/popular

- **Description:** Popular movies (alias for trending)
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/movies/popular`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (1346ms)`

### 80. `GET` /v1/livetv/channels

- **Description:** Channels from all 3 sources (LiveTV, Moochat, PicaTV)
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/livetv/channels`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (3623ms)`

### 86. `GET` /v1/football/live
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-football-live`
- **Description:** Currently live matches
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/football/live`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (4245ms)`

**Response Structure Example:**
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "creator": "DaraTech",
  "matches": []
}
```

### 88. `GET` /v1/football/leagues
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-football-leagues`
- **Description:** Available football leagues
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/football/leagues`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (4096ms)`

### 89. `GET` /v1/football/match/:id/stream
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-football-match-stream`
- **Description:** Stream URL for a football match
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/football/match/1/stream`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (2926ms)`

**Response Structure Example:**
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "creator": "DaraTech",
  "url": "",
  "type": "hls",
  "drm": null,
  "subtitles": []
}
```

- **Description:** Search anime only
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/search/anime?q=naruto`

### 101. `GET` /v1/manga/search
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-manga-search`
- **Description:** Search manga by title
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/manga/search?q=avengers`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (4417ms)`

**Response Structure Example:**
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "creator": "DaraTech",
  "results": [
    {
      "title": "Deadpool: Samurai",
      "url": "https://rosyscans.id/manga/deadpool-samurai/",
      "image": "https://rosyscans.id/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/DeadpoolSamurai.webp",
      "chapter": "Chapter 26",
      "type": "manga"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 118. `GET` /v1/mangadex/tags
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-mdx-tags`
- **Description:** All MangaDex tags grouped by category
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/mangadex/tags`
- **Response Status:** `200 OK (9143ms)`

### 124. `GET` /v1/mangadex/manga/:id/covers
- **Endpoint ID:** `ep-mdx-manga-covers`
- **Description:** All cover art with CDN URLs
- **Live Tested URL:** `https://apimovie.runflix.name.ng/v1/mangadex/manga/a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b/covers?limit=20&page=1`
